guard.set_sha256_of: sha256 over the domain tag toktier.fastokens.unicode_guard.v1 followed by NUL, then the sorted code points as U+XXXX joined by newline

derived_against.domain: U+0000..U+10FFFF, surrogates excluded, no Python-side prefilter
derived_against.probe: four shapes per code point X: X, a+X, X+U+0334, a+X+U+0334; judge and engine each asked whether they reorder; four NFC-normalizing families

guard.behaviour: a request whose text contains any code point in the set is answered by the pinned reference implementation (path hf_full_fastokens_unicode_skew_guard); the guard is by document, not by the reordering position, so it is wider than the divergence it neutralises
